items.text: Opaque save bar — the header save row and sticky bottom save bar use a solid --background-secondary surface (no blur bleed-through) so scrolling settings never show through the buttons.
Opaque tab navigation — main config tabs (General, Theme, Pages, …) sit on the same solid chrome; classic layout negative margins align the bar with panel edges.
Modern/glass action bar — config header chrome matches the opaque treatment instead of semi-transparent glass over scrolling content.
Scoped box model — removed the global * { margin: 0; padding: 0 } reset from config CSS; box-sizing is scoped to #config-main so portaled overlays keep their spacing.
Full-width config tabs — main tab links (general … help) distribute evenly across the bar; opaque chrome background still spans the full container width.
Tab bar border cleanup — removed the stray top/right box border past the last tab; the config tab row uses a bottom edge only so no orphan line appears at the right.

Theme drift fixed — auto dark mode no longer overwrites your saved theme id in settings; VisualSettings.resolveTheme() and ThemeLoader.resolveDisplayTheme() compute the display variant while the stored palette stays stable.
Unified apply path — dashboard, config, health, and page-layout-sync share VisualSettings.applyAutoDarkMode() / applyDisplayTheme(); Auto background presets follow the resolved display theme.
Config FOUC guard — data-auto-dark-mode on the config <html> element; theme-loader.js and visual-settings.js load early on config/health.

Dashboard auto-dark apply — setupDOM() no longer overwrites the resolved display theme with the raw saved theme id after initializeAutoDarkMode(); data-auto-dark-mode syncs on the dashboard so config and dashboard match (e.g. light theme + auto dark on a light system).
Phone vs tablet config — only phones (≤768px) get the reduced General + Help layout; portrait tablets and wider touch viewports keep full config tabs, Essentials/Advanced layers, and guided tours.
Mobile panel order — on phone, General panels reorder to language → theme → layout for a clearer top-to-bottom flow.
Sticky layer chrome — in Advanced and All, the Essentials/Advanced toolbar and section nav stay pinned while scrolling long General pages.
Advanced nav wrapping — section links wrap to multiple lines instead of forcing horizontal scroll; labels renamed to Fine-tuning and Display options where clearer.
Show all grouping — All mode inserts an Advanced sections divider between Essentials and Advanced nav links; nav filters to the active layer in Essentials/Advanced.
URL ↔ layer sync — syncLayerFromUrlOrStorage() restores the saved Essentials/Advanced/All layer on load; bare #general no longer forces Essentials when you had Advanced stored.
Mobile hash guard — deep links like #general/advanced/status scroll only to phone-visible panels instead of switching layers.
Reset panel guard — the destructive Reset card no longer auto-expands when you jump to it from the section nav.
Bookmark checks link — Essentials status Bookmark checks → respects unsaved-changes confirm before switching to the Bookmarks tab.
Layer toggle semantics — Essentials/Advanced/Show all use role="group" with aria-pressed instead of incomplete tab roles; layer switch has visible :focus-visible rings.
Section nav state — active jump links set aria-current="location" as you scroll.
Collapsible panels — panel headers expose aria-controls on a dedicated .general-card-body wrapper for screen readers.
Smart collections master — the master checkbox sets aria-checked="mixed" when some (not all) collection toggles are on.
Search index on translate — applyTranslations() debounces refreshIndex() (120 ms) so settings search picks up relabelled UI without a full language reload.
Layer switch index — debounced rebuild when Essentials/Advanced/All changes; syncMobileLayout({ rebuildIndex: false }) avoids duplicate builds during translation passes.
Phone search scope — mobile settings search uses isPhoneLayout() (≤768px) so tablet-width config keeps the desktop search index.
Search field width — settings search uses flexible min(24rem, 100%) sizing without a fixed min-width that overhangs the chrome on wide viewports.
Help & manual — Config → General help, README, and MANUAL document opaque chrome, phone vs tablet config, theme sync, and nav wrapping.

Cache-bust — whats-new-v84 (2026.06-dashboard-release-v67); dashboard.js?v=theme-sync-2; config.css?v=config-tabs-border-1; config-save-bar.css?v=config-tabs-full-1; settings-search-edge-1; theme-sync-1 on theme-loader.js / visual-settings.js; search-index-refresh-1 on settings search and language bundles; prior whats-new-v83 and config layer bundles retained.
